title: Every message. A next step.
headline:
Every message.
A next step.
scene: Deep slate navy scene. Right half has one glossy dark desktop inbox window with three clearly separated message cards labelled exactly New, Assigned, Resolved; use simple avatar circles and horizontal lines instead of gibberish text. A small tilted phone repeats one cyan message bubble in foreground. Large white sans headline left, small cyan RELAY wordmark. Cool rim light, restrained cyan-green highlights, polished product staging with no invented metrics.
